notes.title: ✈️ FLIGHT RISK ✈️ - Now On Steam!
notes.content:
Fight Risk is a minimalistic desk job game where you play as an air traffic controller trying to save a rogue flight. Master the communication systems before it's too late, or just wing it and see what happens!

[b]This is a SHORT game about deciphering systems and interactions. You will fail many times before you succeed.[/b]

You can check it out here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3013880

notes.title: My newest game, "You Are Atlas" is live!
notes.content:
I just finished my newest game, [url=https://youareatlas.com]You Are Atlas[/url], which is available for free online!

You Are Atlas is a website about holding up the sky. If there no users are on the site, the sky falls. The sky has already fallen 1060 times.

If you're sick of walking around in a Loop, try holding up the sky.
